children.name: Auxenochlorella protothecoides
children.description: Auxenochlorella protothecoides, formerly known as Chlorella protothecoides, is a facultatively heterotrophic green alga in the family Chlorellaceae.

children.name: Prototheca wickerhamii
children.description: Prototheca wickerhamii is a ubiquitous green alga that does not have chlorophyll.

children.name: Prototheca zopfii
children.description: Prototheca zopfii is a ubiquitous achlorophyllic (without chlorophyll) green alga.

children.name: Chlorella sorokiniana
children.description: Chlorella sorokiniana is a species of freshwater green microalga in the division Chlorophyta.

children.name: Chlorella vulgaris
children.description: Chlorella vulgaris is a species of green microalga in the division Chlorophyta.

children.name: Mucidosphaerium pulchellum
children.description: Mucidosphaerium pulchellum, also known by its synonym Dictyosphaerium pulchellum, is a species of freshwater green algae, in the family Chlorellaceae.
